Slots for [brg_home-hero]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. `text`/`textarea` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`, which would double-escape and render as visible entity text.\n\nTHE

IS NOT WIRED. home-hero's headline carries a structural
— `We're in the business
of making your day great.` — and NO slot type can carry one: text/textarea escape it into a visible <br>, and html is an ACF wysiwyg that returns

-wrapped content nested inside the

. The field cannot express the design, so this one stays code regardless of what Sean rules on the other four.

sub.label: Sub copy
sub.doc: Sits under the marker underline, capped at 52ch. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write `&` and `—` as literal characters.
sub.default: From a classic Board & Brew sandwich to a slice at Odie's — we're here for the moments that matter.

tagline.label: Yellow tagline
tagline.doc: The short line beneath the sub, in the display face. White, not yellow, per the comp. ~40 characters.
tagline.default: Good food. Real people. Rad experience.
